Looking for Chrome plugin to keep user away from dangerous sites

The easiest way to do what you want is to change the computers DNS. You can use Norton ConnectSafe (199.85.126.20 and 199.85.127.20). It blocks access to all malware, phishing, scam and porn sites. If you try to access those websites you get a warning similar to this. Sites not on their list are unaffected.

As far as extensions go check the chrome store. I never used any of those. The only one I'm familiar with is WOT which has an option to display a warning when trying to access untrusted sites. Combine that with ublock origin and Disconnect.

Some antivirus and firewall software offer similar functions.
